blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former Sen. Antonio “Sonny” Trillanes IV’s allegations involving China-linked funds and other financial transactions cannot simply be disregarded because he will no longer testify in Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s impeachment trial, prosecution spokesperson Atty. Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr. said over the weekend. Tolosa said the allegations are serious enough to warrant scrutiny against official financial records expected to be presented before the Senate impeachment court beginning Monday. “These are very serious allegations na hindi puwedeng isang tabi lang basta-basta. So kailangan tingnan pa rin natin ’yan,” Tolosa said during the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in […]...
